lessons.lesson_title: E-Commerce Business Models & The Modern Retail Landscape
lessons.what_is_taught: D2C, B2C, B2B, and hybrid commerce models; marketplace (Amazon, Flipkart) dependency vs owning independent brand storefronts; customer lifetime value (LTV), unit margins, and return-to-origin (RTO) risks.
subtopics: Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) vs Wholesale B2B vs Multi-Vendor Marketplaces
Unit economics: Gross Margin, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), ROAS, and Average Order Value (AOV)
Indian e-commerce dynamics: Cash on Delivery (COD) economics, RTO mitigation, and omnichannel touchpoints
Case analysis of leading D2C brands (packaging, positioning, margin structures)
lessons.why_it_matters: A store's technical configuration must be directly dictated by its business model, margin structure, and operational fulfillment profile.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deconstructs a brand brief to evaluate business model viability, catalog margin thresholds, and distribution channels.
lessons.expected_outcome: A completed Business Model Evaluation Dossier outlining revenue streams, channel strategy, and target gross margins.
lessons.example: Analyzing how an organic skincare brand balances 70% direct web sales with 30% marketplace presence.

lessons.lesson_title: Platform Architecture: Shopify vs WooCommerce & TCO Modeling
lessons.what_is_taught: Detailed technical and economic comparison: Shopify (hosted SaaS, proprietary Liquid engine, app ecosystem, transaction fees) vs WooCommerce (open-source WordPress, self-hosted, GPL database ownership, zero platform transaction fees); 3-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) financial modeling.
subtopics: Shopify SaaS model: hosting, SSL, PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance, app recurring subscriptions, and payment processing fees
WooCommerce self-hosted model: managed cloud hosting, domain, plugin licensing, security maintenance, and custom database ownership
Platform decision matrix: SKU volume, client technical capability, budget, customization requirements, and payment gateway support
Building a dynamic 3-year Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) financial model in Google Sheets
lessons.why_it_matters: Recommending the wrong platform leads to costly replatforming projects, merchant frustration, and operational bottlenecks.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds an interactive platform selection scorecard and financial TCO calculator comparing Shopify and WooCommerce for a specified client scenario.
lessons.expected_outcome: A client-ready Platform Recommendation & 3-Year TCO Comparison Spreadsheet with transparent operational projections.
lessons.example: Calculating when a merchant doing ₹15 Lakhs/month saves money on WooCommerce vs Shopify Basic plus app subscriptions.

lessons.what_is_taught: Information architecture for transactional websites: customer journey mapping from acquisition to post-purchase confirmation; 3-tier catalog taxonomy (Department > Category > Subcategory); sitemap structuring, header/footer navigation schemas, and trust page requirements.
subtopics: Customer purchasing journey: discovery, product evaluation, cart commitment, checkout, and tracking
Designing intuitive catalog taxonomies and faceted filter hierarchies without overwhelming users
Hierarchical sitemap generation: Primary navigation, Utility menu, Mega-menus, and Footer compliance columns
Statutory business information and trust policies: Terms of Service, Refund Policy, Privacy Policy, and Shipping/Contact disclosures
lessons.why_it_matters: Clear information architecture reduces cognitive friction, prevents cart abandonment, and ensures approval from payment gateways.
lessons.what_learner_does: Constructs an interactive visual sitemap and navigation tree in FigJam, accompanied by complete legal and trust page requirements.
lessons.expected_outcome: A published store sitemap diagram and content inventory checklist for all transactional and informational pages.
lessons.example: Structuring a 120-SKU apparel catalog with nested collections: Gender > Category > Fabric/Occasion.

lessons.lesson_title: Domain Infrastructure, DNS, SSL & Merchant Onboarding Protocols
lessons.what_is_taught: Domain registration, DNS record management (A, CNAME, TXT, MX), SSL/TLS certificate validation, transactional email routing (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), merchant staff role permissions, and client project scope quotation.
subtopics: Domain registration best practices and brand domain portfolio strategy (.in, .com)
Configuring DNS records: A records for root domain, CNAME for www subdomain, and TXT for domain ownership verification
Enforcing HTTPS/SSL encryption and understanding PCI-DSS compliance requirements
Transactional email authentication: SPF and DKIM DNS records to prevent order emails from landing in spam
Merchant collaborator access vs staff accounts: granting secure agency permissions without sharing owner passwords
Client onboarding: requirement sign-off, milestone delivery timeline, and transparent freelance quotation formulas
lessons.why_it_matters: Proper DNS and role configurations protect client assets, ensure reliable transaction notifications, and prevent catastrophic downtime.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures DNS records on a domain sandbox, verifies SSL certificates, and drafts a comprehensive client statement of work (SOW) and quotation.
lessons.expected_outcome: A verified domain DNS routing report, collaborator access setup, and a signed Client Project Implementation Plan with milestone pricing.
lessons.example: Setting up collaborator permissions in Shopify Partner Admin to manage a client store without requiring the client's master password.

modules.hands_on_practice: Complete an end-to-end e-commerce discovery brief, develop an interactive 3-year TCO comparison model in Google Sheets, build a visual store sitemap in FigJam, and configure DNS/SSL routing for a staging storefront.
modules.assignment: Deliver an E-Commerce Business Feasibility & Architecture Dossier for 'Aura Botanicals' including client brief analysis, platform decision matrix, sitemap, TCO projection, and DNS implementation checklist.
modules.business_application: The foundational discovery and advisory service offered by professional e-commerce agencies and consultants to win high-ticket implementation retainers.
modules.expected_outcome: A client-ready commercial implementation blueprint and verified domain staging environment ready for catalog loading.
modules.assessment_criteria: Complete TCO comparison spreadsheet and DNS diagnostic audit with 100% routing accuracy.

modules.module_title: Product Catalogs, Information Architecture & Inventory Operations
modules.module_purpose: Master product data engineering across Shopify and WooCommerce: titles, descriptions, SKU generation schemas, multi-dimensional variant matrices, pricing/tax rules, multi-location inventory, collection automation, bulk CSV migration, and AI attribute standardization.
what_you_will_learn: Structure commercial product identifiers: human-readable SKU schemas, barcodes (EAN/UPC), and HSN tax codes.
Configure simple and complex variable products across multi-dimensional attributes (Size, Color, Material, Pack Size).
Implement inventory management: safety stock, backorder policies, low-stock notifications, and multi-location fulfillment tracking.
Build manual and automated/smart collections using multi-condition rules (tags, vendors, price brackets, inventory levels).
Prepare, clean, and validate 500-SKU master product spreadsheets in Google Sheets with formulas and regex sanitization.
Execute flawless bulk CSV catalog import and export cycles on BOTH Shopify and WooCommerce with zero data truncation.
Leverage generative AI for prompt-assisted attribute extraction, benefit-driven product copy, and CSV standardization.

lessons.lesson_title: Product Identifiers, SKU Schemas & Structured Attributes
lessons.what_is_taught: Product anatomy: product titles, handle/slug, unique identifier hierarchies, SKU formulation logic (Category-Brand-Style-Color-Size), barcode types (UPC, EAN-13), Indian HSN codes, and structured product attributes.
subtopics: Anatomy of an e-commerce product data model: Title, Handle, Description, Vendor, Product Type
Designing scalable human-readable SKU schemas (e.g., AUR-SKN-SRM-50ML-01) for warehouse and catalog efficiency
Global Trade Item Numbers (GTINs), EAN-13, and UPC barcodes: when they are mandatory for Google Shopping
Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) codes for Indian statutory GST compliance
Defining global vs custom attributes: Weight, Dimensions, Shelf Life, Ingredients, and Material specifications
lessons.why_it_matters: Standardized SKUs and identifiers eliminate fulfillment dispatch errors, enable multi-channel feed syndication, and ensure accurate GST invoicing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Develops an enterprise SKU naming taxonomy and populates a master catalog schema for 30 distinct product items.
lessons.expected_outcome: A verified SKU Generator and Attribute Reference Guide implemented with spreadsheet formulas.
lessons.example: Translating 'Organic Rosehip Night Serum 50ml' into SKU AUR-SER-RHP-50ML with HSN 33049910.

lessons.lesson_title: Simple vs Variable Products & Multi-Dimensional Variants
lessons.what_is_taught: Product type classification: Simple products, Virtual/Downloadable items, and complex Variable products; multi-dimensional variant combinations (Size x Color x Material); platform variant boundaries (Shopify 100-variant limit vs WooCommerce unlimited attribute combinations).
subtopics: Simple physical products vs digital downloadable files (download limits, expiry, license keys)
Variable products: generating attribute option combinations (e.g., 4 Sizes x 5 Colors = 20 variations)
Setting unique SKUs, pricing, sale prices, cost-of-goods (COGS), and stock quantities per individual variant
Navigating platform variant ceilings: Shopify's native 100-variant limit and when to utilize split products or third-party options apps
WooCommerce variation architecture: default attributes, bulk variation price updates, and variation image galleries
lessons.why_it_matters: Variable products represent over 80% of retail apparel and consumer goods; broken variant pricing or stock leads to customer loss and revenue leakage.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds complex variable products with individual variant pricing, SKU mapping, and unique high-resolution imagery in both Shopify and WooCommerce.
lessons.expected_outcome: Live multi-variant product pages on both platforms featuring functional dropdowns/swatches and responsive pricing updates.
lessons.example: Configuring a hoodie with 5 sizes and 4 colors (20 variants) where XXL incurs a ₹200 price surcharge.

lessons.what_is_taught: Inventory lifecycle management: continuous stock tracking, low-stock threshold triggers, backorders and pre-orders, multi-location inventory fulfillment (Warehouse vs Retail Store), and category/collection organization (Manual vs Smart/Automated collections).
subtopics: Inventory tracking modes: track quantity vs continue selling when out of stock (backorder workflows)
Multi-location inventory tracking in Shopify: assigning stock across main warehouse, 3PL hub, and physical retail stores
Low-stock automated email/dashboard alerts and threshold configurations
Shopify Collections: Manual collections vs Automated/Smart collections using multi-condition filters (tags, price brackets, vendor, stock > 0)
WooCommerce product categories, tags, product attributes, and hierarchical menu placement
Faceted search and category sorting rules: Featured, Best Selling, Price Low-to-High, and Date Added
lessons.why_it_matters: Automated collections and precise multi-location stock tracking prevent out-of-stock overselling and save hundreds of hours of manual catalog administration.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures multi-location inventory rules, establishes low-stock notifications, and sets up 6 automated smart collections driven by product tags and stock levels.
lessons.expected_outcome: A dynamic collection ecosystem automatically sorting in-stock products into promotional and departmental showcases.
lessons.example: Creating a 'Sale Under ₹999' smart collection that auto-populates products where compare_at_price > price and price <= 999 and inventory > 0.

lessons.lesson_title: Bulk CSV Migration, Data Validation & AI Attribute Standardization
lessons.what_is_taught: Catalog data engineering: structure of Shopify CSV (38 columns) and WooCommerce standard CSV schemas; data sanitization, URL image linking, bulk data validation; using generative AI for prompt-driven attribute extraction, description standardization, and CSV error fixing.
subtopics: Shopify Product CSV architecture: Handle, Title, Body (HTML), Vendor, Type, Tags, Option Names/Values, Variant SKU, Price, Image Src
WooCommerce Product CSV schema: ID, Type, SKU, Name, Short description, Regular price, Categories, Images
Bulk image hosting and public CDN URL formatting for seamless image import
Using Claude/ChatGPT for bulk catalog operations: parsing unstructured supplier text into structured tabular attributes, writing SEO meta titles, and fixing character encoding issues
Data validation protocols: verifying required columns, checking for duplicate handles/SKUs, validating numerical prices, and running pre-import dry runs
Executing bulk imports, auditing import log errors, and performing zero-data-loss rollback procedures
lessons.why_it_matters: Manual entry of 500+ products is unviable for agency projects; mastering bulk CSV transformations allows launching enterprise catalogs in hours instead of weeks.
lessons.what_learner_does: Takes a messy 50-item raw supplier dataset, uses AI prompts and Google Sheets formulas to clean and format it into valid Shopify and WooCommerce CSVs, and executes error-free imports.
lessons.expected_outcome: Two successfully imported 50-SKU live catalogs on Shopify and WooCommerce with 100% attribute fidelity and zero import errors.
lessons.example: Using an AI regex prompt to parse raw text like 'Size: Large | 100% Cotton | Navy Blue' into distinct Option1 and Option2 CSV columns.

modules.hands_on_practice: Prepare a standardized 50-SKU master product catalog in Google Sheets with complete variant matrices, SKU rules, HSN codes, and public image URLs; execute bulk CSV imports into both a clean Shopify development store and a local WooCommerce staging site.
modules.assignment: Deliver a verified Master Product Catalog Spreadsheet (50 SKUs) and submit live import verification screenshots demonstrating functional variant swatches, accurate inventory counts, and automated collection grouping on both platforms.
modules.business_application: Catalog migration and architecture is a high-demand standalone agency service for merchants re-platforming or expanding product lines.
modules.expected_outcome: Two production-grade, structured product catalogs deployed across Shopify and WooCommerce with zero data discrepancies.
modules.assessment_criteria: Flawless import of a 50-product multi-variant catalog with verified pricing, stock levels, and collection sorting.

modules.module_purpose: Architect and design commercial-grade, high-converting Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) online storefronts using Shopify Online Store 2.0 (OS 2.0), modular theme sections, dynamic Metafield/Metaobject data bindings, mobile UX optimization, customer accounts, conversion funnels, and native Shopify AI/automation tools.
what_you_will_learn: Deploy and configure non-expiring Shopify Partner Development Stores with complete merchant settings, currencies, and tax rules.
Master Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme architecture: JSON templates, dynamic sections, app blocks, and theme customizer controls.
Build responsive, high-converting storefront layouts: sticky headers, hero sections, featured collections, social proof, and multi-column footers.
Architect dynamic data modeling using Shopify Metafields and Metaobjects (size guides, material specifications, FAQ accordions) linked directly to theme blocks without custom code.
Optimize mobile-first e-commerce UX: thumb-zone tap targets, sticky add-to-cart bars, variant image switching, and seamless cart drawers.
Configure checkout settings, discount codes, customer account portals, and statutory store policy pages.
Audit, select, and integrate essential Shopify apps (product reviews, faceted search, back-in-stock alerts) while preserving page performance.
Utilize Shopify Magic and Sidekick for in-admin generative copy, packshot background editing, and store management suggestions.
Build event-driven operational automations using Shopify Flow for inventory alerts, high-risk order tagging, and customer loyalty segmentation.

lessons.lesson_title: Shopify Partner Setup, Admin Configuration & Theme Foundation
lessons.what_is_taught: Shopify Partner ecosystem; creating non-expiring client development stores; comprehensive store settings: currency (INR), timezones, staff permissions, payment gateway modes, tax settings, and shipping origins; Online Store 2.0 reference themes (Dawn, Craft, Sense, Refresh); theme installation and child theme versioning.
subtopics: Shopify Partner Program overview: benefits of development stores, revenue share, and ownership transfer protocols
Configuring master store settings: General details, Store currency, Timezones, and Units of measurement
Setting up collaborator permissions for secure client handoff
OS 2.0 theme architecture: lightweight open-source reference themes (Dawn vs Craft)
Theme installation, duplicate/backup versioning before making edits, and theme code preview modes
lessons.why_it_matters: Correct store settings prevent billing currency errors and tax miscalculations, while development stores allow building full sites without running down client trial clocks.
lessons.what_learner_does: Sets up a fresh Shopify Partner Development Store for 'Aura Botanicals', configures all administrative parameters, and initializes the customized Dawn theme.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully initialized Shopify development store passing the 20-point admin preflight configuration checklist.
lessons.example: Creating an 'Aura Botanicals Staging' store under partner account with transfer-ready settings.

lessons.lesson_title: Visual Storefront Building: Sections, Blocks & Homepage Architecture
lessons.what_is_taught: Online Store 2.0 Theme Customizer deep dive; building modular homepages using dynamic sections (Image banner, Rich text, Featured collection, Image with text, Multi-column, Collage, Video); configuring section settings, block reordering, and color schemes; header architecture (mega-menus, logo alignment, announcement bars) and multi-column footer layouts.
subtopics: Anatomy of OS 2.0 sections: Header, Template sections, and Footer groups
Hero section design: high-impact banner imagery, typography hierarchy, and primary call-to-action (CTA) buttons
Curating high-converting homepage sections: Featured Collection grids, Brand Storytelling, Value Proposition badges, and Video showcases
Announcement bar: rotating promotional messages, free shipping countdowns, and currency selectors
Header navigation: configuring multi-tier dropdown menus and nested mega-menus mapped to smart collections
Footer architecture: 4-column layout including Quick Links, Customer Care, Newsletter capture, and trust payment icons
lessons.why_it_matters: The homepage establishes immediate brand credibility; a cluttered or poorly structured homepage drives bounce rates above 60%.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a complete, branded homepage for an organic skincare brand with custom announcement bar, hero section, collection grids, social proof, and trust footer.
lessons.expected_outcome: A published, visually stunning homepage with seamless navigation and verified click paths to all major collections.
lessons.example: Configuring a rotating announcement bar: 'Free Shipping Across India on Orders Above ₹999 | 100% Cruelty-Free'.

lessons.lesson_title: Product Page Architecture, Metafields & Dynamic Metaobjects
lessons.what_is_taught: High-converting product detail page (PDP) engineering; default product template customization; dynamic data modeling with Shopify Metafields (single-line text, rich text, files, dates) and Metaobjects (nested structured entities); dynamic source linking without writing Liquid code; configuring variant pickers, sticky cart buttons, collapsible tabs, and trust badges.
subtopics: Conversion-optimized Product Page layout: Image gallery, breadcrumbs, price/discount display, variant swatches, and Quantity selectors
Creating custom Metafields for products: Key Ingredients, Skin Type suitability, How to Use instructions, and Storage warnings
Building Metaobjects for structured reusable content: 'Ingredient Spotlight' profiles linking name, image, and botanical benefits
Connecting Metafields dynamically to theme collapsible row blocks and text blocks via the dynamic source icon
Configuring sticky Add-to-Cart drawer/bar for mobile conversion retention
Integrating social proof: customer review widgets (Judge.me) with star rating snippets below product titles
lessons.why_it_matters: Over 70% of e-commerce ad traffic lands directly on product detail pages; static, generic product pages fail to convert discerning buyers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates 5 custom product Metafields and 1 Metaobject, binds them dynamically to the OS 2.0 product template, and integrates star ratings.
lessons.expected_outcome: A dynamic, high-converting product detail page template that automatically displays unique specifications for each product item.
lessons.example: Dynamically displaying an 'Organic Cold-Pressed Rosehip' badge and ingredient tab exclusively on serum product pages.

lessons.lesson_title: Collection Pages, Search, Filtering & Mobile UX Optimization
lessons.what_is_taught: Collection page templates: grid/list views, pagination, collection hero banners, and SEO descriptions; Shopify Search & Discovery app: faceted product filtering (Price, Availability, Size, Color, Category); mobile-first e-commerce UX: viewport breakpoints, mobile navigation drawers, touch target sizing, and responsive image compression.
subtopics: Collection template customization: banner layouts, product cards, vendor display, secondary image on hover, and quick-view modals
Configuring the official Shopify Search & Discovery app: customizing search algorithms, product boosts, and faceted filter menus
Mobile-first e-commerce UX principles (Baymard Institute standards): 48px tap targets, thumb-zone cart reachability, and uncluttered sticky controls
Auditing and optimizing mobile image assets: WebP compression, lazy loading, and eliminating layout shifts (CLS < 0.05)
Mobile checkout journey testing: simulating mobile purchase flows on iOS and Android viewports
lessons.why_it_matters: Over 75% of Indian e-commerce orders originate on smartphones; poor mobile filtering and slow collection grids cause immediate customer exit.
lessons.what_learner_does: Installs Search & Discovery, configures multi-attribute facet filters, optimizes all imagery for mobile viewports, and audits mobile usability.
lessons.expected_outcome: A mobile-optimized collection browsing experience with sub-second facet filtering and verified mobile responsiveness.
lessons.example: Configuring filter facets allowing shoppers to filter skincare products simultaneously by 'Skin Concern', 'Price Range', and 'In Stock'.

lessons.lesson_title: Cart Experience, Customer Accounts, Discounts & Policy Pages
lessons.what_is_taught: Cart architectures: Drawer cart (slide-out), page cart, and popup cart; free shipping progress bars; native customer accounts (classic vs new customer accounts); discount rules: percentage, fixed amount, buy X get Y (BOGO), and automatic tiered discounts; drafting and publishing statutory policy pages (Terms, Refund, Privacy, Shipping).
subtopics: Cart UX: configuring the AJAX slide-out cart drawer with product thumbnails, quantity toggles, order notes, and sticky checkout button
Gamified cart incentives: implementing a dynamic free shipping progress bar (e.g., 'Add ₹250 more to unlock FREE shipping')
Customer account setup: New customer accounts (passwordless 6-digit email OTP) vs Classic accounts
Discount engine mastery: coupon codes vs automatic discounts, minimum spend conditions, customer eligibility, and usage limits
Drafting and styling mandatory legal and informational pages: Privacy Policy, Refund Policy, Terms of Service, Shipping Policy, and Contact Us form
lessons.why_it_matters: A high-friction cart experience or missing legal pages leads to cart abandonment and merchant gateway rejections.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a slide-out cart drawer with dynamic upsells, creates automatic tiered promotional discount rules, and publishes all compliant policy pages.
lessons.expected_outcome: A polished cart and checkout onboarding sequence with active tiered discounts and verified policy links.
lessons.example: Configuring an automatic 15% discount for first-time customers spending over ₹1,499.

lessons.lesson_title: Shopify AI (Magic & Sidekick), Shopify Flow & Store Launch Readiness QA
lessons.what_is_taught: Shopify native AI capabilities: Shopify Magic (in-admin product description generation, tone settings, FAQ creation, email copy) and Sidekick conversational operations; Shopify Flow: event-driven automated workflows (triggers, conditions, actions); 100-point pre-launch store quality assurance audit; store versioning, backups, and preview link generation.
subtopics: Leveraging Shopify Magic: generating benefit-driven product copy, subject lines, and image background generation directly in admin
Shopify Sidekick overview: querying store metrics and implementing conversational administrative changes
Shopify Flow fundamentals: building automated workflows for low-inventory alerts, tagging high-value VIP customers, and flagging potential fraud
Shopify app ecosystem hygiene: vetting apps for script weight, reviewing permissions, and testing uninstall residue
100-Point Pre-Launch QA Checklist: link checking, test order simulation (Bogus Gateway), tax verification, mobile audit, and speed testing
Generating shareable preview links for client review and presenting the completed D2C store
lessons.why_it_matters: A store launched without rigorous QA experiences payment failures, broken links, and negative first impressions that ruin marketing campaigns.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds 2 operational Shopify Flow workflows, utilizes Shopify Magic for 10 product descriptions, and conducts a 100-point pre-launch QA audit on their demo store.
lessons.expected_outcome: A launch-ready Shopify D2C store accompanied by a completed 100-Point Pre-Launch QA Audit Report and shareable preview link.
lessons.example: Building a Flow workflow: 'When Order is Placed -> If Order Total > ₹5,000 -> Add Customer Tag VIP and Send Slack Notification'.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a complete, functional Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) demo store on Shopify Partner development environment ('Aura Botanicals') with custom OS 2.0 sections, dynamic Metafield/Metaobject bindings, Search & Discovery filters, slide-out cart drawer, discount rules, policy pages, Shopify Magic AI copy, Shopify Flow automation, and mobile QA evidence.
modules.assignment: Submit a fully functional Shopify D2C Storefront deliverable including: 1) Active Shopify Preview Link, 2) Completed 100-Point Pre-Launch QA Audit Checklist, 3) High-Resolution Theme Screenshots (Desktop & Mobile), 4) Master Product Catalog (30+ SKUs with Metafields), and 5) Mobile Usability & Speed Evidence.
modules.business_application: Turnkey Shopify store design and launch is the primary high-ticket revenue driver for e-commerce freelancers and agency founders.
modules.expected_outcome: A commercial-grade, fully functional Shopify D2C store that demonstrates mastery of modern OS 2.0 design, AI integration, and operational automation.
modules.assessment_criteria: Full functional inspection of a responsive Shopify D2C store with customized navigation, dynamic metafields, and tested app blocks.

modules.module_purpose: Master self-hosted e-commerce architecture using WordPress 6.7+ and WooCommerce 9.x: local staging environments with LocalWP, Full Site Editing (FSE) block themes, WooCommerce product modeling, modern Cart/Checkout blocks, High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), Elementor integration, and disaster recovery staging protocols.
what_you_will_learn: Deploy zero-cost local WordPress development environments using LocalWP with PHP 8.2+ and MySQL 8.0.
Configure WooCommerce 9.x core settings: currencies, shipping zones, tax rules, and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
Build Simple, Variable, Grouped, and Downloadable products with variation swatches and attribute combinations.
Customize WooCommerce storefront templates using WordPress Block Editor (FSE), block patterns, and theme.json styles.
Implement modern block-based Cart and Checkout flows with address autocomplete and express payment buttons.
Configure customer my-account portals, order lifecycle statuses, transactional emails, and discount coupon rules.
Build bespoke promotional landing pages using Elementor where relevant while maintaining site speed.
Execute WordPress security hardening, role/permission governance, and zero-downtime staging-to-production migration using UpdraftPlus.

lessons.lesson_title: WordPress Architecture, LocalWP Staging & Site Configuration
lessons.what_is_taught: WordPress core architecture (wp-content, wp_posts, wp_postmeta, database tables); setting up offline local staging environments using LocalWP; PHP memory limits (512MB), execution timeouts, and MySQL settings; general settings: permalinks (/product/%postname%/), timezones, SSL trust certificates, and user roles (Administrator, Shop Manager, Customer).
subtopics: WordPress ecosystem: Core software, themes, plugins, and database relationship architecture
Setting up LocalWP: configuring local domains (.local), PHP version switching (8.2/8.3), and One-Click Admin login
Server prerequisites: memory_limit, max_execution_time, upload_max_filesize, and Redis/LiteSpeed object caching concepts
Permalinks and URL structuring for optimal e-commerce SEO indexing
User role hierarchy and security: Shop Manager vs Administrator access limitations
lessons.why_it_matters: A flawed server environment or incorrect permalink structure causes checkout errors, slow page loading, and catastrophic database bloat.
lessons.what_learner_does: Spins up a local WordPress staging instance via LocalWP, optimizes server directives, and configures SEO-friendly permalinks and user roles.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully configured local WordPress staging server passing all Site Health checks with zero warnings.
lessons.example: Allocating 512MB memory limit in wp-config.php to prevent fatal timeout errors during heavy WooCommerce operations.

lessons.lesson_title: WooCommerce 9.x Core Setup, HPOS & Product Architecture
lessons.what_is_taught: WooCommerce installation and onboarding wizard; High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) database architecture vs legacy postmeta; store configuration: location, selling countries, currency formatting (INR ₹), and inventory stock settings; creating Simple, Variable, Virtual, Downloadable, and Grouped products with attributes and variation swatches.
subtopics: WooCommerce 9.x setup wizard: configuring store location, currency formatting, and measurement units
High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS): dedicated order tables (wc_orders) for massive performance and scalability
Product type engineering: Simple physical goods, downloadable digital files, and complex Variable items
Custom attributes vs global taxonomy attributes (Size, Color, Material) and variation swatches
Inventory operations: stock management, backorder notifications, low-stock thresholds, and individual variant pricing/SKUs
lessons.why_it_matters: Understanding HPOS and clean product attribute architecture enables stores to handle 10,000+ orders without slowing down the WordPress admin.
lessons.what_learner_does: Installs WooCommerce 9.x, enables HPOS, and populates 15 multi-variant industrial products with custom variation swatches and tiered pricing.
lessons.expected_outcome: A functional WooCommerce store catalog featuring clean variant options and verified HPOS order storage.
lessons.example: Configuring an industrial drill with 3 voltage options and 2 battery pack variations (6 variants) with custom SKU codes.

lessons.lesson_title: WordPress Block Editor, Site Editor & WooCommerce Templates
lessons.what_is_taught: Modern WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg) and Full Site Editing (FSE); block-based theme architecture (theme.json design tokens); creating and editing custom WooCommerce templates: Single Product template, Product Catalog / Archive template, and Taxonomy Archive; utilizing WooCommerce core blocks (Product Title, Gallery, Add to Cart, Product Price, Filter by Attribute).
subtopics: Full Site Editing (FSE) concepts: Template Parts, Block Patterns, and global design styles in theme.json
Customizing the Single Product block template: rearranging gallery layout, sticky Add to Cart, and tabbed descriptions
Designing the Shop Archive page: grid columns, pagination, product sorting dropdowns, and category header banners
Integrating WooCommerce blocks: Product Collection, Filter by Price, Filter by Attribute, and Active Filters
Zero-bloat performance optimization: achieving 90+ mobile PageSpeed scores using pure block architecture without heavy page builders
lessons.why_it_matters: Block themes deliver modern, lightning-fast storefronts that pass Google Core Web Vitals while giving designers complete visual template control.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a custom single product and shop archive layout using FSE blocks with attribute filtering and zero layout shift.
lessons.expected_outcome: Published block-based WooCommerce templates rendering dynamic product information with 100% mobile responsiveness.
lessons.example: Customizing a single product template to place an attribute pill selector directly above a high-visibility sticky purchase button.

lessons.lesson_title: Cart & Checkout Blocks, Account Portals & Order Lifecycle
lessons.what_is_taught: Modern WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks; block-based checkout customization (express payment methods, address fields, phone number requirements); My Account customer portal; coupon code creation (fixed cart, percentage, free shipping, usage limits); order management lifecycle (Pending, Processing, Completed, Cancelled, Refunded); customizing HTML transactional customer emails.
subtopics: WooCommerce Cart Block: cross-sell item carousels, free shipping indicators, and inline coupon application
WooCommerce Checkout Block: one-page accordion checkout, address validation, order notes, and terms acceptance checkbox
Customer Account dashboard: order history, downloadable file access, default billing/shipping address management
Coupon engine configuration: expiry dates, minimum spend rules, individual use restrictions, and exclude sale items
Order processing workflow: changing order statuses, adding private customer/admin order notes, and generating customer invoices
Branded transactional emails: customizing header logos, brand palette colors, and footer details for order confirmations
lessons.why_it_matters: Default checkout pages often look outdated; modern block checkouts dramatically reduce friction and drive higher completion rates.
lessons.what_learner_does: Replaces legacy shortcodes with modern Cart & Checkout blocks, builds 3 promotional coupons, and tests the end-to-end order processing lifecycle.
lessons.expected_outcome: A frictionless block-based checkout pipeline with branded transactional email dispatch on simulated orders.
lessons.example: Configuring a coupon code `WELCOME10` offering 10% off for orders over ₹999 with a limit of 1 use per customer.

lessons.lesson_title: Visual Page Building with Elementor & Responsive Store Customization
lessons.what_is_taught: Utilizing visual page builders for bespoke e-commerce experiences: Elementor interface overview, container-based Flexbox/Grid layouts, WooCommerce dynamic widgets (Product Title, Price, Add to Cart, Woo Breadcrumbs); designing high-converting promotional landing pages and custom storefront sections; mobile breakpoint styling and responsive asset optimization.
subtopics: Elementor architecture: Sections/Columns vs modern Flexbox and Grid layout containers
WooCommerce dynamic tags and template widgets in visual builders
Designing a high-converting single-product promotional micro-landing page with sticky purchase trigger
Responsive breakpoint design: desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport overrides for typography and padding
Performance considerations: managing script bloat, disabling unneeded Elementor experiments, and CSS asset minimization
lessons.why_it_matters: Many agency clients mandate Elementor-based storefronts; mastering both Block Editor and Elementor ensures maximum freelance employability.
lessons.what_learner_does: Designs a dedicated B2B product showcase landing page in Elementor with custom specifications table and inquiry form.
lessons.expected_outcome: A pixel-perfect, responsive promotional landing page integrated seamlessly with WooCommerce cart actions.
lessons.example: Building a dedicated promotional page for a wholesale heavy-duty tool set featuring a dynamic countdown timer and bulk inquiry button.

lessons.lesson_title: Plugin Compatibility, Security, Disaster Recovery & Staging-to-Production
lessons.what_is_taught: E-Commerce plugin ecosystem governance; auditing plugins for database performance and PHP compatibility; WordPress hardening: login attempt throttling, two-factor authentication (2FA), disabling XML-RPC, and secure database table prefixes; complete site backup and migration using UpdraftPlus; local staging to live hosting deployment workflow.
subtopics: Plugin hygiene protocols: vetting active installations, security audit histories, and PHP 8.x compatibility
Security hardening essentials: preventing brute-force logins, enforcing strong admin passwords, and SSL security headers
Database maintenance: cleaning transient caches, post revisions, and optimizing WooCommerce database tables
Disaster recovery planning: configuring automated daily backups to cloud storage (Google Drive / S3) with UpdraftPlus
Staging-to-production deployment: database URL search-and-replace, SSL certificate activation, and post-migration smoke testing
lessons.why_it_matters: A hacked store or failed plugin update can destroy client businesses overnight; disciplined backup and security protocols are mandatory for professional agencies.
lessons.what_learner_does: Applies security hardening rules, configures automated cloud backups, and executes a full site migration export package.
lessons.expected_outcome: A hardened, secure WooCommerce store with a restorable backup archive and verified migration procedure.
lessons.example: Using UpdraftPlus to take an encrypted database snapshot before performing core WooCommerce major version updates.

modules.hands_on_practice: Spin up a local staging environment in LocalWP, configure WooCommerce 9.x with HPOS, create a 15-SKU multi-variant product catalog, design custom FSE block templates, build a modern Cart/Checkout flow, and generate an UpdraftPlus disaster recovery backup archive.
modules.assignment: Submit a fully functional WooCommerce Staging Store deliverable: 1) Admin configuration audit report, 2) Live screenshots of variable product pages with swatches, 3) Verified modern block checkout flow, 4) Restorable UpdraftPlus .zip backup file, and 5) Security hardening checklist.
modules.business_application: The complete self-hosted commerce implementation service delivered by agency web developers for clients demanding full data ownership and zero SaaS transaction fees.
modules.expected_outcome: An independently functional, production-grade WooCommerce store capable of handling complex variant pricing, modern block checkouts, and reliable backups.
modules.assessment_criteria: Complete functional inspection of a responsive WooCommerce store with verified HPOS storage, working variant swatches, block checkout, and restorable backup archive.

modules.module_title: Storefront UX, Mobile CRO & Conversion Architecture
modules.module_purpose: Master e-commerce user experience (UX) and conversion rate optimization (CRO) across desktop and mobile devices: shopping journey friction audits, Baymard Institute e-commerce usability standards, above-the-fold product page optimization, mobile thumb-zone navigation, transparent pricing signals, ethical scarcity, and session recording analysis using Microsoft Clarity.
what_you_will_learn: Analyze the end-to-end shopping journey from traffic acquisition to post-purchase confirmation to eliminate friction points.
Implement Baymard Institute e-commerce usability guidelines across homepage, collection navigation, and checkout.
Architect high-converting Product Detail Pages (PDP): image galleries, thumb-zone variant selectors, sticky CTA bars, and tabbed specifications.
Eliminate price opacity: clear GST display, estimated delivery date widgets, transparent return policies, and zero hidden shipping costs.
Design mobile-first cart experiences: slide-out AJAX cart drawers, free shipping progress bars, and in-cart order bumps.
Incorporate authentic trust architecture: verified review integrations (Judge.me), security seals, and manufacturer certifications.
Apply ethical conversion optimization: avoiding dark patterns, fake countdown timers, or fabricated inventory counts.
Deploy Microsoft Clarity to analyze click heatmaps, scroll depth, and user session recordings to diagnose drop-off zones.

lessons.lesson_title: The E-Commerce Customer Journey & Discovery UX
lessons.what_is_taught: Anatomy of the customer buying journey: awareness, exploration, product consideration, commitment, and checkout; cognitive load reduction on homepages and collection pages; intuitive category discovery, faceted search filters, breadcrumb navigation, and zero-search-result failover recovery.
subtopics: Mapping user cognitive stages: Browsers vs Searchers vs Discount Hunters
Homepage visual hierarchy: hero value proposition, quick-access category shortcuts, and social proof anchors
Category and collection browsing UX: sticky filter sidebars, multi-attribute facet selection, and dynamic product count counters
Predictive search design: instant autocomplete, thumbnail previews, typo tolerance, and suggested trending queries
Designing zero-results pages: offering helpful collection links and top-selling recommendations instead of dead ends
lessons.why_it_matters: If a shopper cannot locate an item within 3 clicks or 15 seconds, they bounce to a competitor; discovery UX directly impacts catalog conversion.
lessons.what_learner_does: Audits a live commerce catalog navigation flow, identifies 5 discovery friction points, and restructures collection menus with predictive search.
lessons.expected_outcome: An optimized discovery wireframe and faceted navigation hierarchy with verified search autocomplete.
lessons.example: Implementing predictive search that displays matching product thumbnails and stock status as the user types 3 letters.

lessons.lesson_title: Product Detail Page (PDP) Architecture & Conversion Triggers
lessons.what_is_taught: Above-the-fold PDP anatomy: high-resolution image zoom galleries, clear pricing typography, tax-inclusivity callouts, visual variant pill selectors, interactive size guides, accordion tabs (Ingredients, Dimensions, Care), verified review badges, and reassure badges (Free Shipping, Easy Returns).
subtopics: Above-the-fold desktop and mobile PDP hierarchy: keeping Title, Price, Reviews, and Primary CTA visible without excessive scrolling
Optimizing product media: 1:1 square packshots, contextual lifestyle imagery, video demonstrations, and mobile swipe gestures
Variant selector design: visual color swatches, button pills (not generic dropdowns), and cross-out styling for out-of-stock sizes
Interactive size guides and specification tables to drastically reduce return rates
Social proof integration: displaying verified customer review summaries and star rating distributions near product titles
Reassurance trust icons: 30-day money-back guarantee, secure checkout, and official brand warranty callouts
lessons.why_it_matters: Over 65% of paid traffic lands directly on the PDP; small improvements in layout clarity and trust signals generate immediate revenue gains.
lessons.what_learner_does: Redesigns a standard e-commerce PDP into a high-converting conversion page with dynamic swatches, size chart popup, and verified review stars.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully optimized, mobile-responsive product detail page scoring 90+ on Baymard usability benchmarks.
lessons.example: Adding an interactive popup size guide with exact measurements (chest, length) to prevent customer sizing doubt.

lessons.lesson_title: Mobile Cart Usability, Frictionless Navigation & Ethical Scarcity
lessons.what_is_taught: Mobile-first cart engineering: slide-out AJAX drawer cart vs cart page; thumb-zone ergonomics; dynamic free-shipping progress indicators; in-cart order bumps (accessories, gift packaging); pricing transparency (no surprise charges at checkout); ethical CRO principles vs deceptive dark patterns.
subtopics: Mobile thumb-zone ergonomics: placing primary conversion buttons within natural thumb reach on 6.5+ inch smartphone screens
AJAX slide-out drawer cart: instant confirmation upon clicking Add to Cart without page reloads
Gamified progress incentives: dynamic free-shipping progress bar (e.g., 'Add ₹150 more to unlock FREE Delivery')
In-cart cross-sells and order bumps: one-click add-ons (warranty, sample packs, complementary items)
Pricing transparency: displaying inclusive GST taxes and estimated shipping upfront to prevent checkout abandonment
Ethical CRO: rejecting fake countdown timers, fabricated '3 people viewing this' alerts, and misleading strikethrough prices
lessons.why_it_matters: Unexpected shipping fees or taxes at checkout cause 48% of cart abandonments; upfront clarity builds lasting customer trust.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a responsive slide-out cart drawer with dynamic progress bar and one-click accessory order bump on both Shopify and WooCommerce.
lessons.expected_outcome: A seamless mobile cart drawer with verified real-time calculation and ethical conversion triggers.
lessons.example: Configuring a progress bar that dynamically updates as items are added: 'You are ₹200 away from FREE Shipping!'.

lessons.lesson_title: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Auditing, Heatmaps & A/B Testing Principles
lessons.what_is_taught: Conversion auditing methodology: Baymard Institute 40-point UX audit framework; installing and configuring Microsoft Clarity (or Hotjar); analyzing click heatmaps, scroll depth maps, rage clicks, and dead clicks; identifying checkout abandonment funnels; principles of split/AB testing (hypothesis formulation, sample size, statistical significance).
subtopics: The CRO audit framework: Heuristic evaluation across Homepage, Category, PDP, Cart, and Checkout
Setting up Microsoft Clarity: tracking tag installation, masking sensitive customer data, and session recording filtering
Reading heatmaps: identifying whether users scroll past the hero section or miss critical action buttons
Diagnosing rage clicks and dead clicks: uncovering broken links, unclickable images, and unresponsive form inputs
A/B testing methodology: formulating data-backed hypotheses, defining success metrics, and avoiding testing with insufficient traffic
Conducting before-and-after conversion audits on a training storefront
lessons.why_it_matters: Data-driven UX audits allow agencies to charge ₹35,000–₹75,000 for standalone CRO consulting retainers backed by session evidence.
lessons.what_learner_does: Integrates Microsoft Clarity, performs a comprehensive 40-point usability audit on a sample store, and produces a prioritized before/after optimization report.
lessons.expected_outcome: A professional E-Commerce UX & CRO Audit Dossier containing heatmap analysis, identified friction points, and implemented fixes.
lessons.example: Identifying that 40% of mobile users rage-clicked an unlinked promotional banner, and converting it into a clickable collection link.

modules.hands_on_practice: Conduct a 40-point Baymard Usability & Mobile CRO Audit on an existing training store, implement sticky Add-to-Cart controls, configure an AJAX slide-out cart drawer with dynamic free-shipping incentives, and deploy Microsoft Clarity to analyze user interactions.
modules.assignment: Submit a comprehensive E-Commerce CRO & Storefront UX Dossier: 1) 40-point UX scorecard, 2) Before/after visual evidence of PDP optimization, 3) Verified mobile cart drawer with order bump, and 4) Microsoft Clarity heatmap summary highlighting friction resolutions.
modules.business_application: High-ticket conversion rate optimization and usability auditing services demanded by scaling D2C brands to lower customer acquisition costs.
modules.expected_outcome: An audited, high-converting storefront journey optimized for mobile shoppers with zero checkout friction and ethical persuasion triggers.
modules.assessment_criteria: Complete UX audit documentation demonstrating measurable friction reductions, verified mobile responsiveness, and ethical CRO compliance.

modules.module_title: Checkout Architecture, Indian Payment Gateways, Statutory GST & Security
modules.module_purpose: Master transactional checkout architecture, payment gateway integration, Cash on Delivery (COD) operations, statutory Indian GST compliance, and payment security across Shopify and WooCommerce: Razorpay/Cashfree sandbox testing, simulated success/failure scenarios, refund lifecycles, COD OTP fraud prevention, CGST/SGST/IGST tax matrices, automated B2B invoicing, and SSL/MFA credential protection.
what_you_will_learn: Architect frictionless checkout pipelines: single-page checkouts, guest checkouts, and express digital wallet integrations.
Understand Indian payment infrastructure realities: UPI, NetBanking, credit/debit cards, EMI, and third-party gateway limitations on Shopify in India.
Integrate Razorpay and Cashfree sandbox payment gateways on both Shopify and WooCommerce using official API test keys.
Simulate end-to-end payment transactions: successful captures, simulated card declines, network timeouts, and partial/full refunds.
Implement Cash on Delivery (COD) verification workflows: OTP phone authentication, automated COD fees, and RTO risk mitigation.
Configure Indian statutory GST tax engines: tax-inclusive vs exclusive pricing, HSN codes, and automatic CGST/SGST vs IGST state splitting.
Implement automated B2B GST invoicing: collecting customer GSTIN at checkout and issuing legal tax invoices.
Enforce e-commerce security standards: HTTPS/SSL encryption, admin multi-factor authentication (MFA), webhook signature verification, and secure credential handling.
key_concepts: Cash on Delivery (COD) & OTP Fraud Prevention

lessons.lesson_title: Checkout Architecture, Customer Data & Platform Boundaries
lessons.what_is_taught: Checkout journey architecture: Customer Information, Shipping Address, Shipping Method, and Payment; guest checkout vs account-mandatory models; address autocomplete; field optimization; platform checkout constraints (Shopify checkout restrictions on non-Plus plans vs open WooCommerce checkout customization); checkout failure recovery workflows.
subtopics: Anatomy of modern checkouts: Single-page checkout vs 3-step checkout funnels
Guest checkout vs mandatory customer account creation: impact on checkout abandonment rates
Form field optimization: removing non-essential fields, setting phone number as primary identifier, and postal code auto-fill
Understanding Shopify checkout plan boundaries: checkout branding and app blocks on Basic/Shopify plans vs Checkout Extensibility
WooCommerce checkout freedom: customizing checkout fields using filters and Checkout Blocks without core modification
Abandoned checkout recovery: automated recovery email sequences and SMS notification triggers
lessons.why_it_matters: Checkout is the most financially sensitive stage of an online store; excessive fields or confusing navigation causes up to 70% of potential buyers to abandon.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures optimized checkout settings on both platforms: enables guest checkout, sets phone number validation, and tests abandoned checkout recovery.
lessons.expected_outcome: A streamlined, frictionless checkout process capturing essential customer and address data with zero redundant fields.
lessons.example: Enabling 1-page checkout on Shopify with address autocomplete to reduce mobile checkout completion time by 40%.

lessons.lesson_title: Indian Payment Gateway Integration & Sandbox Transaction Testing
lessons.what_is_taught: Indian e-commerce payment gateway landscape: Razorpay, Cashfree, and PayU; reality of Shopify Payments (not available natively for Indian domestic entities; third-party gateway requirement); gateway setup: creating free developer sandbox accounts, API Key ID and Key Secret configuration; webhook listeners; simulating UPI, card, and NetBanking test transactions.
subtopics: Payment ecosystem analysis: Payment Aggregators (Razorpay, Cashfree) vs Payment Gateways vs Merchant Banks
Shopify in India reality: configuring approved third-party payment providers (Razorpay Payment Gateway, Cashfree) without Shopify Payments
Setting up Razorpay and Cashfree Developer Sandbox accounts with simulated test modes
Installing and configuring payment plugins: WooCommerce Razorpay plugin and Shopify Third-Party Provider setup
Executing test transactions using standard sandbox credentials: UPI success/failure strings, test credit cards (success, 3DS OTP, declined, insufficient funds)
Payment settlement concepts: Authorization vs Auto-Capture, T+2 settlement cycles, rolling reserves, and simulated full/partial refunds
lessons.why_it_matters: Improper payment gateway configuration results in declined transactions, lost revenue, and delayed settlement payouts.
lessons.what_learner_does: Connects Razorpay sandbox to both Shopify and WooCommerce staging stores, runs 5 test transactions (UPI, card success, card decline), and verifies order status transitions.
lessons.expected_outcome: Verified payment gateway integration processing simulated UPI and card payments with correct order confirmation status.
lessons.example: Simulating a successful UPI transaction in Razorpay sandbox using `success@razorpay` virtual payment address.

lessons.lesson_title: Cash on Delivery (COD) Operations & Fraud Risk Mitigation
lessons.what_is_taught: Cash on Delivery (COD) mechanics in India (accounting for 50%+ of orders in Tier 2/3 cities); financial reality of Return to Origin (RTO) shipping penalties; configuring COD payment methods; implementing COD order confirmation via phone OTP verification; setting COD fee surcharges; defining maximum COD order value thresholds.
subtopics: The economics of COD in Indian retail: why customers demand it and how RTO courier costs erode profitability
Configuring native Cash on Delivery in WooCommerce and Shopify with custom checkout instructions
Implementing phone OTP verification: verifying customer mobile numbers before confirming COD orders to prevent bogus purchases
Configuring COD surcharge fees (e.g. ₹50 extra for COD orders) to incentivize prepaid UPI payments
Restricting COD availability: setting minimum/maximum order value limits (e.g. no COD above ₹5,000) and disabling COD for high-RTO postal pincodes
lessons.why_it_matters: Unverified COD orders result in 20%–35% RTO rates in Indian e-commerce; automated OTP verification cuts fake orders by over 60%.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures Cash on Delivery with an automated OTP verification step and ₹50 convenience fee surcharge on a staging storefront.
lessons.expected_outcome: A functional COD payment pipeline protected by automated phone verification and clear customer delivery terms.
lessons.example: Triggering a 4-digit OTP SMS verification modal when a customer selects Cash on Delivery at checkout.

lessons.lesson_title: Indian Statutory GST Tax Engine & Automated Invoicing Compliance
lessons.what_is_taught: Statutory Indian Goods and Services Tax (GST) principles for e-commerce; tax-inclusive vs tax-exclusive retail pricing; configuring GST tax rates (0%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%); Intra-state supply (CGST + SGST split) vs Inter-state supply (IGST); HSN/SAC code mapping per product category; collecting customer GSTIN at checkout for B2B input tax credit; generating legal tax invoices.
subtopics: Indian GST compliance framework: CGST (Central), SGST (State), and IGST (Integrated) tax distribution rules
Tax-inclusive pricing standards in consumer retail: ensuring prices shown on storefront include all applicable taxes
Configuring WooCommerce tax tables and Shopify tax settings based on merchant shipping origin state
Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) codes: assigning mandatory 4-digit and 6-digit HSN codes to product catalogs
B2B GSTIN collection: adding customer GST number and company name fields to checkout with format regex validation
Automating legal PDF GST tax invoices: generating invoices displaying merchant GSTIN, customer GSTIN, tax breakdown table, and signature block
lessons.why_it_matters: Incorrect GST calculation or non-compliant invoicing leads to severe tax penalties, commercial disputes, and loss of B2B corporate customers.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a complete Indian GST tax matrix with 5%, 12%, and 18% rates, runs test checkouts from intra-state and inter-state addresses, and inspects the generated PDF tax invoice.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully verified statutory GST tax engine accurately splitting CGST/SGST or applying IGST with compliant automated B2B invoices.
lessons.example: Verifying that a customer in Maharashtra buying from a Mumbai store gets charged 9% CGST + 9% SGST, while a customer in Delhi gets charged 18% IGST.

lessons.lesson_title: Payment Security, Credential Safety, MFA & End-to-End Checkout QA
lessons.what_is_taught: E-Commerce transaction security standards: HTTPS/SSL encryption, PCI-DSS compliance scope for merchants; secure credential handling (never sharing live API keys or storing customer credit card data); admin multi-factor authentication (MFA); webhook signature verification; end-to-end checkout quality assurance (QA) protocol.
subtopics: PCI-DSS compliance: why merchants use hosted payment gateways to avoid touching raw credit card numbers
Secure API key management: separating test keys from live production keys and storing secrets safely
Enforcing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) on all Shopify, WordPress, and Payment Gateway admin accounts
Webhook signature validation: verifying that incoming order paid webhooks originate from the authentic payment gateway server
Comprehensive 25-Point Checkout QA Checklist: testing discount codes, tax splits, address edge cases, mobile wallets, and refund flows
Emergency payment failure procedures: diagnosing gateway downtime and configuring temporary failover payment methods
lessons.why_it_matters: A single compromised credential or broken checkout integration destroys merchant reputation and risks catastrophic financial liability.
lessons.what_learner_does: Conducts a 25-point checkout security and transaction QA audit across both training storefronts, simulating edge cases and verifying webhook signatures.
lessons.expected_outcome: A signed Checkout & Payment Integration QA Audit Report confirming secure, compliant transaction processing across all payment modes.
lessons.example: Verifying that sandbox API secrets are properly masked and not exposed in public client-side JavaScript source code.

modules.hands_on_practice: Configure and verify end-to-end checkout workflows on BOTH Shopify and WooCommerce training stores: connect Razorpay sandbox mode, simulate UPI and Card test transactions, implement Cash on Delivery with phone verification, configure Indian statutory GST (CGST/SGST/IGST), and generate compliant automated tax invoices.
modules.assignment: Submit a complete Checkout, Payments & GST Compliance Dossier: 1) Verified transaction logs showing simulated UPI and Card payments, 2) Test refund receipt, 3) Indian GST tax engine configuration audit showing intra-state vs inter-state tax splits, 4) Sample compliant B2B tax invoice PDF, and 5) Signed 25-Point Checkout QA Checklist.
modules.business_application: The core commercial payment and tax integration service required by every Indian retail brand to legally and securely process online orders.
modules.expected_outcome: A production-ready checkout infrastructure supporting UPI, Cards, NetBanking, and COD with 100% statutory GST compliance and zero security vulnerabilities.
modules.assessment_criteria: Flawless test payment simulation across UPI, Card, and COD modes with accurate GST invoice generation displaying correct HSN and tax splits.

modules.module_purpose: Master e-commerce physical distribution, courier aggregator integration, order fulfillment workflows, and return management across India and global markets: weight and volumetric dimensional rate rules, Shiprocket multi-carrier integration, AWB label generation, branded real-time tracking pages, delivery notifications (Email/SMS/WhatsApp), Return to Origin (RTO) prevention, and reverse logistics automation.
what_you_will_learn: Configure shipping zones, flat rates, tiered weight-based matrices, and free shipping thresholds on Shopify and WooCommerce.
Calculate dimensional volumetric weight (L x W x H in cm / 5000) and establish packaging dimension standards to safeguard profit margins.
Integrate Shiprocket multi-courier logistics with store channels, map pickup warehouse addresses, and configure courier allocation priorities.
Execute end-to-end fulfillment workflows: order picklists, packing slips, manifest generation, and Air Waybill (AWB) shipping label printing.
Build branded customer tracking pages with live courier status milestones to eliminate 'Where Is My Order' (WISMO) support queries.
Configure automated dispatch and delivery notification triggers via Email, SMS, and WhatsApp webhooks.
Mitigate Return-to-Origin (RTO) courier penalties using Non-Delivery Report (NDR) automation and address verification.
Architect customer self-service return, exchange, and refund workflows with inventory restock and exception management.

lessons.lesson_title: Shipping Profiles, Weight/Volumetric Calculation & Local Delivery
lessons.what_is_taught: E-Commerce shipping architecture: shipping origin locations, domestic zones (Metro, Rest of India, Remote/NE), and international profiles; actual dead weight vs volumetric dimensional weight `(L x W x H in cm / 5000)`; configuring flat rates, price-tiered rates, free shipping thresholds (e.g. Free above ₹999), local radius delivery, and in-store pickup rules.
subtopics: Shipping zone segmentation: Intra-city, Regional, Metro-to-Metro, Rest of India, and Special zones (J&K, North-East)
Volumetric weight mathematics: how courier carriers charge by dimensional weight and how poor box sizing doubles freight bills
Configuring Shopify Shipping Profiles: custom rates for fragile, oversized, or perishable product collections
WooCommerce Table Rate Shipping: creating multi-tier rules combining cart weight and cart subtotal thresholds
Local commerce options: postal-code-restricted local on-demand delivery and store pickup schedules
lessons.why_it_matters: Shipping cost miscalculations directly destroy merchant gross margins or cause severe cart abandonment if rates appear excessive.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a complete multi-tier shipping rate profile on both Shopify and WooCommerce with dead-weight and volumetric thresholds.
lessons.expected_outcome: A functional shipping calculator at checkout applying correct zone rates based on customer pincode and cart weight.
lessons.example: Applying a ₹100 standard shipping fee that automatically drops to ₹0 when the cart subtotal exceeds ₹999.

lessons.lesson_title: Shiprocket Multi-Carrier Logistics Integration & AWB Label Generation
lessons.what_is_taught: Indian courier aggregator ecosystem: Shiprocket, Delhivery, and NimbusPost; creating developer demo accounts, connecting store sales channels via API; setting primary warehouse pickup addresses; multi-courier comparison engine (courier recommendation score, shipping rates, estimated transit time, RTO risk score); automated Air Waybill (AWB) generation, shipping label printing, and courier pickup scheduling.
subtopics: Logistics aggregator architecture: how Shiprocket unifies 25+ courier partners (Delhivery, Blue Dart, DTDC, Shadowfax, Xpressbees)
API channel integration: auto-syncing paid orders from Shopify and WooCommerce to the logistics dashboard
Configuring warehouse pickup addresses, merchant contact details, and Return-to-Origin return hub addresses
Courier allocation rules: prioritizing lowest rate vs fastest transit time vs highest delivery success score
Order packaging and documentation: generating barcoded thermal shipping labels (4x6 inch), packing slips, and pickup manifests
lessons.why_it_matters: Manual courier booking takes 10+ minutes per order; automated aggregator integration enables a single warehouse worker to dispatch 200+ orders an hour.
lessons.what_learner_does: Connects a Shiprocket test account to a training store, syncs test orders, assigns couriers, and prints test shipping labels with real AWB numbers.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully integrated logistics pipeline with generated shipping labels displaying valid barcodes, customer address, and declared value.
lessons.example: Auto-assigning Delhivery Surface for a 2kg industrial drill order and generating a 4x6 AWB shipping label with barcoded routing.

lessons.lesson_title: Order Fulfillment Workflows, Tracking Pages & Real-Time Notifications
lessons.what_is_taught: Order lifecycle status transitions: Unfulfilled -> Picked -> Packed -> In Transit -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered; attaching carrier tracking numbers; automated tracking link generation; building a branded tracking page on the store's primary domain; customer post-purchase notification channels: automated transactional emails, SMS triggers, and WhatsApp business message templates.
subtopics: Store admin status updates: marking orders fulfilled, generating tracking numbers, and notifying customer accounts
Building a branded tracking page (e.g. `brand.com/track-order`) instead of sending customers away to third-party courier websites
Reducing 'Where Is My Order' (WISMO) support queries through proactive multi-stage delivery milestones
Transactional notification architecture: Event-triggered dispatch emails, out-for-delivery alerts, and delivery confirmations
WhatsApp commerce notifications in India: using Interakt / Wati sandbox for automated dispatch updates with tracking links
lessons.why_it_matters: Proactive tracking updates reduce customer support ticket volume by up to 50% and turn the post-purchase tracking page into a repeat-purchase channel.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a branded order tracking page, triggers a simulated dispatch, and verifies the automated customer notification sequence.
lessons.expected_outcome: An active customer order tracking page rendering real-time courier milestone steps and simulated WhatsApp/email notifications.
lessons.example: Sending an automated WhatsApp alert: 'Hi Rahul! Your Aura Botanicals order #1042 has shipped via Blue Dart. Track live: novaskills.in/track?awb=12345'.

lessons.lesson_title: Return-to-Origin (RTO) Mitigation, Reverse Logistics & Exchange Workflows
lessons.what_is_taught: Return-to-Origin (RTO) crisis in Indian e-commerce: customer rejection at doorstep, fake courier non-delivery reports (NDR), and double shipping penalties; automated NDR re-attempt workflows; reverse logistics architecture: initiating customer return requests, generating reverse AWB labels, quality check (QC) inspection protocols, restocking inventory, and processing exchanges vs store credit vs refunds.
subtopics: The anatomy of an RTO: distinguishing between customer unavailability, doorstep rejection, incorrect address, and courier fraud
Non-Delivery Report (NDR) automation: triggering automated WhatsApp/IVR messages to customers upon first failed delivery attempt
Establishing return policies: defining return windows (7/14 days), non-returnable categories, and condition requirements
Reverse pickup workflow: generating reverse shipping labels, courier QC verification at doorstep, and transit back to warehouse
Inventory reconciliation: inspecting returned merchandise, restocking undamaged inventory in the database, and issuing refunds or store gift cards
lessons.why_it_matters: Uncontrolled RTO wipes out merchant profits; mastering proactive NDR automation and structured reverse logistics protects business survival.
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures an automated NDR re-attempt workflow and simulates an end-to-end customer return request from pickup to inventory restocking.
lessons.expected_outcome: A documented Reverse Logistics & RTO Mitigation Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) with active return request workflows.
lessons.example: Automating an instant WhatsApp re-delivery scheduler when a delivery fails due to 'Customer Unavailable'.

modules.hands_on_practice: Configure domestic shipping zones and volumetric rates, connect a Shiprocket demo account to Shopify and WooCommerce, sync test orders, generate test shipping labels with AWB tracking numbers, build a branded tracking page, and execute a simulated customer return workflow with inventory restock.
modules.assignment: Submit an End-to-End Logistics & Order Fulfillment Dossier: 1) Shipping zone rate configuration table, 2) Test AWB shipping label and manifest, 3) Live branded tracking page URL/screenshots, 4) Automated notification template proofs, and 5) Reverse logistics & RTO prevention workflow diagram.
modules.business_application: Turnkey supply chain and courier integration consulting for D2C brands expanding fulfillment operations across domestic markets.
modules.expected_outcome: A production-grade logistics engine capable of automated courier allocation, 1-click label printing, proactive customer tracking, and low-RTO management.
modules.assessment_criteria: Complete execution of an order-to-delivery test cycle: rate calculation, AWB generation, live tracking page rendering, and successful reverse return simulation.

modules.module_title: Technical E-Commerce SEO, Analytics & Product Feed Syndication

Diagnose and optimize Google Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and mobile performance using Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse.

lessons.lesson_title: E-Commerce Keyword Research, On-Page Architecture & Structured Data
lessons.what_is_taught: Commercial keyword research for online retail: high-intent product searches vs informational queries; formula-driven SEO product titles (Brand + Attribute + Product Name + Size/Color); meta description optimization; URL slug conventions; resolving duplicate content across variant URLs using self-referencing canonical tags; Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (`Product`, `Offer`, `AggregateRating`, `Brand`, `BreadcrumbList`).
subtopics: Keyword research methodology: finding transactional search terms with buying intent using search suggest and Google Trends
Formulaic title structuring for e-commerce products that balance click-through rate (CTR) and search engine visibility
Canonical URL hygiene: ensuring Shopify `/products/handle` and collection-routed `/collections/all/products/handle` consolidate ranking signals
Writing JSON-LD structured data for Google Rich Results: price, availability, currency, review count, and high-res image arrays
Validating structured data using the Google Rich Results Test and resolving missing field warnings
lessons.why_it_matters: Rich snippet star ratings and in-stock badges increase organic search click-through rates by 25%–35% without spending on paid ads.
lessons.what_learner_does: Optimizes 10 product listings with formulaic SEO titles, writes JSON-LD structured data, and validates them on Google's Rich Results Test tool.
lessons.expected_outcome: A technical SEO audit confirming error-free Product and Breadcrumb Schema markup rendering rich result eligibility.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Search Console, Indexation Governance & Core Web Vitals Performance
lessons.what_is_taught: Google Search Console (GSC) integration; XML sitemap submission and indexation monitoring; managing faceted navigation index bloat using robots.txt and noindex directives; Core Web Vitals optimization: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP < 2.5s), Interaction to Next Paint (INP < 200ms), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS < 0.1); compressing product imagery to WebP/AVIF; auditing with Lighthouse.
subtopics: Verifying store domain ownership in Google Search Console using DNS TXT records
Submitting and auditing XML sitemaps: monitoring indexed pages vs excluded URLs
Preventing crawler traps: managing faceted filter URLs (`?color=blue&size=xl`) with robots.txt rules to conserve crawl budget
Core Web Vitals deep dive: optimizing hero images for LCP, deferring non-critical JavaScript for INP, and reserving image dimensions for zero CLS
Batch WebP image conversion and responsive srcset configuration for mobile performance
lessons.why_it_matters: Google uses page experience and Core Web Vitals as a ranking signal; slow mobile stores lose organic rankings and experience high bounce rates.
lessons.what_learner_does: Audits a store in Google Search Console, identifies crawler exclusions, and optimizes mobile assets to score 90+ on Lighthouse performance.
lessons.expected_outcome: A verified Google Search Console property and a Lighthouse audit report demonstrating green Core Web Vitals metrics.
lessons.example: Preloading the mobile hero image using `<link rel='preload'>` to cut LCP from 3.8s down to 1.6s.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Merchant Center (GMC) & Product Catalog Feed Syndication

Product feed data architecture: mandatory XML/CSV attributes and field character limits
Navigating GTIN/EAN requirements: when barcodes are mandatory and how to configure `identifier_exists = FALSE` for custom-branded goods
Diagnosing and resolving GMC disapproval errors: price mismatches, missing shipping weight, and image watermark policy violations
Enabling free product listings on the Google Shopping tab and syndicating catalog feeds to Meta Advantage+ catalogs

lessons.what_learner_does: Builds a 30-item XML/CSV catalog feed, validates it against Google Merchant Center specifications, and resolves all diagnostic policy warnings.
lessons.expected_outcome: An approved, active Google Merchant Center product feed displaying 100% policy compliance for free Google Shopping surfaces.

lessons.lesson_title: Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Enhanced E-Commerce Measurement & AI Search Awareness

Testing live event firing using Google Tag Assistant and GA4 DebugView
Analyzing checkout funnel abandonment: identifying step-by-step drop-offs from cart to payment capture
Building e-commerce performance reports: evaluating marketing channel ROI (Organic vs Direct vs Social)
User privacy and consent management: configuring cookie consent banners and adhering to data privacy standards
AI search discoverability (AEO/GEO): how LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) parse structured commerce data and product brand citations

Implement high-impact automated lifecycle email funnels in Klaviyo / Brevo: Welcome Series, Abandoned Checkout Recovery, Post-Purchase VIP, and Win-back.
